name: Ryvos Open-Source Local AI Agent Runtime
free_limit: MIT-licensed Rust AI agent runtime and local assistant with command-line interface, persistent memory, task planning, tools, MCP integration and optional messaging channels; self-run binary has no Ryvos software license fee or vendor-imposed local-use quota.
watch_out: Runs on user-controlled Linux/macOS hardware; LLM provider API calls, cloud servers, model subscriptions and optional Docker sandboxing infrastructure may cost extra. Ryvos Cloud is a separate hosted offering and is not included or verified as free; use local models where supported to avoid paid inference.
